name: Change vehicle details on a V5C registration certificate
description: Case type for postal DVLA processing of V5C corrections, vehicle detail changes, like-for-like replacement notifications, and modification-related evidence review.

decision_gates.title: In-scope V5C amendment or notification
decision_gates.check: Confirm the request is for a mistake on the V5C, a reportable vehicle change, or a like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or motorcycle frame replacement that must be notified using V627/1.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Request is outside the V5C amendment and notification process.
exemptions: Like-for-like replacement without change to original appearance or dimensions does not require a V5C update but can proceed as a DVLA notification using V627/1.

decision_gates.title: Tax class routing
decision_gates.check: Confirm the applicant is not attempting to change tax class through the V5C amendment route.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Tax class cannot be changed by updating the V5C and must be handled through the vehicle tax process.

decision_gates.title: Correct form and route
decision_gates.check: Confirm the applicant has used the correct route: section 1 of a new style V5C, section 7 of an older style V5C, V627/1 for like-for-like replacement notifications, V627/3 for structural modifications or electric conversions, and V62 where the latest V5C is unavailable.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Required form, section, or alternative route document is missing or incorrect.
exemptions: V62 may be accepted instead of the latest V5C for like-for-like replacement notifications.

decision_gates.title: Mandatory supporting evidence
decision_gates.check: Confirm all evidence required for the declared change type has been provided, including one acceptable document for engine number or cylinder capacity changes, correct fuel type evidence, plating or design weight evidence for large vehicle weight changes, and all required photos and donor details for like-for-like replacement cases.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Required evidence or written confirmation has not been provided for the declared vehicle change.
exemptions: Current MOT evidence is only required where the vehicle needs an MOT.
MSVA is only required where the motorcycle needs one.
Donor vehicle V5C is only required where replacement parts are not new.

decision_gates.title: Modification and inspection triage
decision_gates.check: Confirm whether the case can be decided on the papers or must be referred for inspection triage because it involves wheel plan, body type, VIN, chassis number, frame number, structural modification, or electric conversion.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Case requires inspection triage before the V5C can be updated or confirmed.
exemptions: No inspection is needed where submitted evidence fully supports a non-complex change and no inspection trigger is present.

decision_gates.title: Decision and certificate issue
decision_gates.check: Confirm the evidence supports the declared change and that the case outcome is update and issue replacement certificate, confirm notification, request inspection, or reject the amendment.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Submitted evidence does not support the requested V5C amendment or notification outcome.

state_transitions.trigger: Postal application or notification received by DVLA
Caseworker begins scope and routing assessment
Mandatory evidence missing or incorrect form identified
Evidence complete and case ready for final outcome
Amendment rejected or redirected out of route

evidence_checklist.name: Latest V5C registration certificate
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for standard V5C amendment cases and like-for-like replacement notifications unless V62 is used instead.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the latest certificate is enclosed and matches the vehicle registration details in the case.

evidence_checklist.name: V62 application form
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required instead of the latest V5C where the applicant does not have the latest V5C for a like-for-like replacement notification.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the V62 is completed and can be used in place of the latest V5C.

evidence_checklist.name: V627/1 Vehicle parts statement
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like replacement of chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or motorcycle frame without changing original appearance or dimensions.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the form is completed and matches the declared parts replacement.

evidence_checklist.name: V627/3 modified vehicle statement
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required where the vehicle has undergone a structural modification or electric conversion.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the statement includes the registration number and details of the modification.

evidence_checklist.name: Engine replacement receipt showing engine number and cylinder capacity
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Accepted evidence for change of engine number or cylinder capacity.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the receipt includes the engine number and cylinder capacity and supports the declared amendment.

evidence_checklist.name: Manufacturer written evidence for engine number or cylinder capacity
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Accepted evidence for change of engine number or cylinder capacity.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the manufacturer evidence supports the declared engine details.

evidence_checklist.name: Insurance inspection report
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Accepted evidence for change of engine number or cylinder capacity where provided for insurance purposes.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the report identifies the vehicle and relevant engine change details.

evidence_checklist.name: Garage confirmation on headed paper
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Accepted for engine number or cylinder capacity changes where the change took place before purchase, and for fuel type changes where the existing engine was converted.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check headed paper authenticity and that the garage confirms the work carried out.

evidence_checklist.name: Receipt for new engine fitted
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for fuel type change where a new engine has been fitted.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the receipt supports installation of a new engine consistent with the declared fuel type change.

evidence_checklist.name: Evidence of electric conversion
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required where the vehicle has been converted to run on electricity.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the evidence supports the electric conversion and aligns with any V627/3 details.

evidence_checklist.name: Current MOT evidence
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for structural modification or electric conversion where the vehicle needs an MOT.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the MOT is current and relates to the vehicle in the case.

evidence_checklist.name: Motorcycle single vehicle approval (MSVA)
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for structural modification or electric conversion where the motorcycle needs one.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check MSVA is provided where applicable and matches the motorcycle details.

evidence_checklist.name: Plating certificate
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Accepted evidence for change to the weight of a large vehicle.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the certificate supports the revised plated or design weight.

evidence_checklist.name: Design weight certificate
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Accepted alternative to a plating certificate for change to the weight of a large vehicle.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the certificate supports the revised vehicle weight.

evidence_checklist.name: Letter explaining an unlisted change
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required where the change is not listed in section 1 or section 7 of the V5C.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the letter clearly explains the change and corresponds with the supporting evidence.

evidence_checklist.name: Donor vehicle V5C for replacement parts
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required where replacement parts used in a like-for-like replacement are not new.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the donor V5C corresponds to the source vehicle for the replacement part.

evidence_checklist.name: Invoice or receipt for replacement chassis with specification
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement notifications.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the invoice or receipt includes the specification of the replacement chassis or equivalent part.

evidence_checklist.name: Photos of whole vehicle and registration plate
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement notifications.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check photos show front, back, both sides, interior, and registration number plate.

evidence_checklist.name: Photo of engine number
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement notifications.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the engine number is visible and legible.

evidence_checklist.name: Photo of VIN stamp or plate on old chassis or frame
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement notifications.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the VIN stamp or plate is visible and relates to the old chassis or frame being replaced.

evidence_checklist.name: Photo of old VIN sticker
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement notifications.
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check the old VIN sticker is visible and legible.

correspondence_templates.name: Acknowledgement of Application
correspondence_templates.subject: We have received your V5C vehicle details update – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We have received your application to change vehicle details on a V5C registration certificate for vehicle registration {{ registration_mark }}.

We will review the information and documents you sent to decide whether we can update the vehicle record, whether we need more evidence, or whether the case needs inspection triage.

If your application is complete and can be decided on the papers, a replacement certificate is usually issued within 2 to 4 weeks for postal applications.

Please keep a copy of anything you send to DVLA. If you have not received your replacement log book within 4 weeks of applying, you should contact DVLA.

This case will be assessed in line with: V5C-SCOPE-01, V5C-FORM-03, V5C-EVID-04 and, where relevant, V5C-INSP-05.

There is no stated statutory appeal or administrative review route in the published process for this case type. If we cannot process your request, we will explain why and what you need to do next.

Yours sincerely,
DVLA Vehicle Registration Casework Team
Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency

correspondence_templates.name: Evidence Request
correspondence_templates.subject: Further information needed for your V5C update – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We need more information before we can continue with your request to change the vehicle details recorded for {{ registration_mark }}.

Please send the following within 28 days of the date of this letter:
{{ outstanding_evidence_list_numbered }}

Examples of evidence we may need include:
- one acceptable document for an engine number or cylinder capacity change
- garage confirmation on headed paper for a fuel type conversion
- V627/1 for a like-for-like chassis, bodyshell or frame replacement
- V627/3 for a structural modification or electric conversion
- a current MOT, if the vehicle needs one
- MSVA, if the motorcycle needs one
- a plating certificate or design weight certificate for a large vehicle weight change
- a letter explaining the change if it is not listed in section 1 or section 7 of the V5C

If we do not receive the required information within 28 days, we may reject your V5C update or be unable to process it further.

This request is made under the evidence requirements in V5C-EVID-04, V5C-FORM-03, V5C-LIKE-06, V5C-MOD-07, V5C-ENG-08, V5C-FUEL-09 and V5C-WEIGHT-10, as applicable to your case.

There is no stated appeal or administrative review deadline in the published process for missing evidence decisions. If your request is rejected, you may need to submit a fresh application with the correct documents.

Yours sincerely,
DVLA Vehicle Registration Casework Team
Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency

correspondence_templates.name: Decision: Approved
correspondence_templates.subject: Decision on your V5C vehicle details application – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We have completed our review of your request for vehicle registration {{ registration_mark }}.

Decision: Approved.

We have accepted the change to the vehicle record based on the information and evidence you provided.

Updated details recorded:
{{ approved_change_summary }}

If a replacement V5C registration certificate is being issued, it should reach you in line with the usual postal timescale of 2 to 4 weeks from application, where the case does not require further intervention.

If your case involved a notification only, such as a like-for-like replacement reported using V627/1, this letter confirms that DVLA has recorded the notification.

If the change affects vehicle tax, DVLA will tell you separately if more vehicle tax must be paid.

This decision has been made with reference to: V5C-SCOPE-01, V5C-FORM-03, V5C-EVID-04 and {{ decision_policy_refs }}.

No statutory appeal or administrative review route is stated in the published process for approved cases. If you believe the updated record is still incorrect, you should contact DVLA with full details.

Yours sincerely,
DVLA Vehicle Registration Casework Team
Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency

correspondence_templates.name: Decision: Refused
correspondence_templates.subject: Decision on your V5C vehicle details application – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We have completed our review of your request for vehicle registration {{ registration_mark }}.

Decision: We cannot process this request.

Reason:
{{ refusal_reason }}

Details:
{{ refusal_detail }}

Common reasons include:
- the request is outside the V5C amendment process
- the request is for a tax class change, which must be made through the vehicle tax process
- the correct form or V5C section was not used
- required evidence was not provided
- the evidence submitted does not support the declared change

Relevant policy references: V5C-SCOPE-01, V5C-TAX-02, V5C-FORM-03, V5C-EVID-04 and {{ decision_policy_refs }}.

If your request relates to tax class, you must use the vehicle tax process instead.
If your request was rejected because evidence was missing or incomplete, you may submit a fresh application with the correct documents.

The published process does not state a statutory appeal right, administrative review route, or reconsideration deadline for this case type. The standard immigration appeal deadlines of 28 days outside the UK and 14 days inside the UK do not apply to this DVLA vehicle registration process.

If you believe we have misunderstood your application, you should write to DVLA with the missing information or corrected documents as soon as possible.

Yours sincerely,
DVLA Vehicle Registration Casework Team
Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency

correspondence_templates.name: Chase for Missing Evidence
correspondence_templates.subject: Reminder: outstanding documents for your V5C update – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

This is a reminder that we are still waiting for the information listed below for vehicle registration {{ registration_mark }}:
{{ outstanding_evidence_list_numbered }}

Please send the outstanding documents by {{ evidence_deadline_date }}.

If we do not receive them by that date, we may reject your request or be unable to update the vehicle record.

This reminder relates to the evidence requirements in V5C-EVID-04 and, where relevant, V5C-LIKE-06, V5C-MOD-07, V5C-ENG-08, V5C-FUEL-09 and V5C-WEIGHT-10.

The published process does not provide a formal appeal or review deadline for this reminder stage. If your request is closed because evidence is not received, you may need to make a new application.

Yours sincerely,
DVLA Vehicle Registration Casework Team
Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency

risk_factors.name: Required evidence missing for declared change
risk_factors.trigger: Any listed change is submitted without the mandatory supporting evidence or written confirmation required for that change type.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Move case to awaiting_evidence, issue evidence request, and reject if evidence is not supplied.

risk_factors.name: Attempt to change tax class through V5C route
risk_factors.trigger: Application seeks to change tax class, including to an exempt class such as disabled, through a V5C amendment.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Refuse the V5C amendment route and direct the applicant to the vehicle tax process.

risk_factors.name: Structural modification or electric conversion without V627/3
risk_factors.trigger: Case declares structural modification or electric conversion but does not include a completed V627/3 modified vehicle statement.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Request V627/3 and pause substantive review until received.

risk_factors.name: Inspection trigger present
risk_factors.trigger: Case involves wheel plan, body type, VIN, chassis number, frame number, or other change identified as potentially requiring inspection.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Escalate for inspection triage and notify the applicant that further checks may be needed.

risk_factors.name: Like-for-like replacement incorrectly submitted as standard V5C update
risk_factors.trigger: Applicant submits a like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement as a standard V5C amendment instead of using V627/1 notification route.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Correct the route, request V627/1 and associated evidence, and hold decision until the correct route is followed.

risk_factors.name: Donor vehicle evidence missing for used replacement parts
risk_factors.trigger: Replacement parts are not new and the V5C of the donor vehicle is not provided.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Request donor vehicle V5C and do not approve until provenance is evidenced.

risk_factors.name: Incomplete photo set for like-for-like replacement
risk_factors.trigger: Photos do not show all required views, engine number, VIN stamp or plate, and old VIN sticker.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Request a complete photo set before continuing review.

risk_factors.name: Application routed to wrong Swansea address
risk_factors.trigger: Postal submission appears intended for SA99 1DZ but was sent to SA99 1BA, or vice versa.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Reroute internally where possible and record the routing issue.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Standard correction or listed change with complete evidence and no inspection trigger.
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Most postal V5C amendments can be handled by standard vehicle registration caseworkers.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Case involves structural modification, electric conversion, wheel plan, body type, VIN, chassis number, or frame number change.
auto_assignment_rules.reason: These cases require specialist review and possible inspection triage.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Case risk score is 21 or above, evidence appears inconsistent, or repeated evidence requests have failed to resolve material discrepancies.
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Senior oversight is needed for complex or high-risk amendment decisions.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Case has been waiting close to the 28 day SLA and all evidence is present for decision.
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Prioritise cases that are decision-ready and approaching the published postal timescale.

policy_references.title: Scope of V5C corrections and vehicle change notifications
policy_references.criteria: Covers mistakes on the V5C, listed vehicle changes, and notifications DVLA must be told about, including like-for-like replacement cases that do not require a V5C update.

policy_references.title: Tax class changes are out of scope for V5C amendment route
policy_references.criteria: Tax class cannot be changed by updating the V5C and must instead be handled through the vehicle tax process.

policy_references.title: Correct form, section and postal route requirements
policy_references.criteria: Requires use of section 1 on new style V5C, section 7 on older style V5C, notes in vehicle details where needed, explanatory letter for unlisted changes, and correct use of V62, V627/1 and V627/3.

policy_references.title: Mandatory evidence for V5C amendments
policy_references.criteria: A V5C update will be rejected if required evidence or written confirmation is not provided for listed changes.

policy_references.title: Inspection triage for complex vehicle changes
policy_references.criteria: DVLA may require inspection for changes such as wheel plan, body type, VIN, chassis number, or frame number, and where evidence alone is insufficient.

policy_references.title: Like-for-like chassis, bodyshell and frame replacement notifications
policy_references.criteria: Where original appearance and dimensions are unchanged, DVLA must still be told using V627/1 with latest V5C or V62, supporting invoices or receipts, donor V5C where used parts are fitted, and required photos.

policy_references.title: Structural modifications and electric conversions
policy_references.criteria: Structural modifications and electric conversions require V627/3 and, where applicable, current MOT evidence, MSVA, and may lead to inspection.

policy_references.title: Engine number and cylinder capacity evidence
policy_references.criteria: Acceptable evidence includes a replacement engine receipt showing engine number and cylinder capacity, manufacturer evidence, insurance inspection report, or garage confirmation where applicable.

policy_references.title: Fuel type change evidence
policy_references.criteria: Fuel type changes require evidence such as receipt for a new engine fitted, garage confirmation on headed paper for conversion work, or evidence supporting electric conversion.

policy_references.title: Large vehicle weight change evidence
policy_references.criteria: Changes to the weight of a large vehicle must be supported by a plating certificate or design weight certificate.

policy_references.title: Postal replacement certificate timescales and follow-up
policy_references.criteria: Postal applications usually result in a replacement certificate within 2 to 4 weeks; applicants should contact DVLA after 4 weeks if not received, and a £25 replacement fee may apply after 6 weeks if DVLA was not notified.

policy_references.title: Postal destination routing
policy_references.criteria: Engine size, fuel type, goods vehicle weight, and bus seating changes are sent to DVLA Swansea SA99 1DZ; other listed changes are sent to DVLA Swansea SA99 1BA.
